stem.text: Which sequence shows the correct order of some of the stages in the production and secretion of an enzyme?

A.text: Golgi body → ribosome → rough endoplasmic reticulum → mRNA

B.text: mRNA → smooth endoplasmic reticulum → Golgi body → vesicle

C.text: ribosome → rough endoplasmic reticulum → vesicle → Golgi body

D.text: smooth endoplasmic reticulum → mRNA → vesicle → ribosome
